description: The bar chart illustrates the Token Ratio (TR) performance of three models, RedWhale, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0, across six categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the TR performance, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick intervals of 0.1. Each category contains three bars, colored dark blue, light blue, and gray, representing RedWhale, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0, respectively. The gray bars consistently reach 1.00 across all categories, while the dark blue bars range from approximately 0.42 to 0.69, and the light blue bars range from approximately 0.46 to 0.74. The bars are grouped by category, with the three models represented side by side. The chart does not display any specific sorting order among the categories, but the bars within each category are consistently ordered by model. The values for each bar are annotated above the bars, with values such as 0.42, 0.46, and 1.00 for PT-EVAL, and 0.61, 0.57, and 1.00 for AVG.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the Token Ratio (TR) performance of three models across six categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick intervals of 0.1. Each category contains three bars representing RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), respectively. Notably, SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 consistently outperforms the other models across all categories, achieving a perfect score of 1.00 in each case. RedWhale demonstrates a steady improvement across the datasets, with its highest performance observed in KoBEST-SN (approximately 0.73). In contrast, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 shows a decline in performance from KoBEST-BQ to KoBEST-HS, where it achieves its lowest score of 0.50. On average, RedWhale slightly surpasses EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, with a mean score of 0.61 compared to 0.57.
